ex.en: It is questionable whether this data can be relied on.
ex.zh: 這些資料可不可靠還很難說。

ex.en: Could I get you to update this data for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我更新這份資料嗎？

ex.en: However, all these data were not confirmed.
ex.zh: 不過，這些資料都還沒有得到證實。

data.en: facts or numbers collected for study or used by a computer

ex.en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
ex.zh: 我們優化了資料庫索引，系統效率因此提高了 50%。

ex.en: Just because it's in Tatoeba.org's database, doesn't mean it's a sentence.
ex.zh: 出現在 Tatoeba 資料庫裡的，不一定就是句子。

database.en: a large set of information stored in a computer so it can be found easily

ex.en: It was daytime.
ex.zh: 那時是白天。

ex.en: The office is quiet during the daytime.
ex.zh: 白天辦公室很安靜。

ex.en: Daytime temperatures will reach 30 degrees.
ex.zh: 白天氣溫會達到三十度。

daytime.en: the part of the day when it is light

ex.en: I have to dash, or I'll miss my train.
ex.zh: 我得趕快走了，不然會趕不上火車。

ex.en: She dashed out of the office to catch the bus.
ex.zh: 她衝出辦公室去趕公車。

dash.en: to run or go somewhere very quickly

ex.en: The injury dashed his hopes of playing in the final.
ex.zh: 這次受傷讓他打決賽的希望破滅了。

ex.en: Bad weather dashed our plans for a beach trip.
ex.zh: 壞天氣讓我們去海邊的計畫泡湯了。

ex.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
ex.zh: 他創下了百米短跑的世界新紀錄。

ex.en: We made a dash for the exit when the rain started.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時，我們衝向出口。

dash.en: a short fast run or race

ex.en: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
ex.zh: 在湯裡加一點鹽。

ex.en: I'd like my tea with a dash of milk.
ex.zh: 我的茶要加一點點牛奶。

dash.en: a small amount of something added to food or drink

ex.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們每天至少應該睡八小時。

ex.en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
ex.zh: 氣溫已經連續好幾天低於零度。

ex.en: Bats sleep during the day.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠白天睡覺。

ex.en: I work during the day and study at night.
ex.zh: 我白天工作，晚上讀書。

day.en: the time when it is light outside

ex.en: You work too hard these days. Aren't you tired?
ex.zh: 你最近工作太拚了，不累嗎？

ex.en: These days, many people work from home.
ex.zh: 現在很多人在家工作。

day.en: at the present time, compared with the past

ex.en: The flood caused a lot of damage.
ex.zh: 洪水造成了很大的損害。

ex.en: The damage will cost us a lot of money.
ex.zh: 這些損壞會讓我們花很多錢。

ex.en: The fire caused serious damage to the factory.
ex.zh: 這場火災對工廠造成了嚴重的損害。

damage.en: harm done to something so that it is broken or less useful

ex.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 上週的暴風雨吹壞了我們社區的許多樹。

ex.en: Tom tried to crack a walnut without damaging its kernel.
ex.zh: 湯姆試著敲開核桃，又不弄壞裡面的果仁。

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現一隻翅膀嚴重受傷的鳥。

damage.en: to harm something so that it is broken or less good

ex.en: They sued the government for damages.
ex.zh: 他們控告政府，要求損害賠償。

ex.en: The court ordered the company to pay damages.
ex.zh: 法院判決公司支付損害賠償。

damage.en: money a court orders someone to pay for harm they have caused

ex.en: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
ex.zh: 一走進漆黑的隧道，我們就什麼都看不見了。

ex.en: The sky grew darker and darker.
ex.zh: 天色越來越暗了。

ex.en: This color is a bit darker than that one.
ex.zh: 這個顏色比那個深一點。

ex.en: He was wearing a dark suit.
ex.zh: 他穿著深色西裝。

dark.en: closer to black than to white in color

ex.en: Cats can see in the dark.
ex.zh: 貓在黑暗中看得見。

ex.en: Many children are afraid of the dark.
ex.zh: 很多小孩都怕黑。

dark.en: the lack of light, or the time when the sun has gone down

ex.en: I'm going to buy a camera for my daughter.
ex.zh: 我打算買一台相機給我女兒。

ex.en: We have got two daughters and two sons.
ex.zh: 我們有兩個女兒和兩個兒子。

ex.en: He has two daughters who have both married doctors.
ex.zh: 他有兩個女兒，都嫁給了醫生。

ex.en: Most people write about their daily life.
ex.zh: 大部分人寫的都是自己的日常生活。

ex.en: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.
ex.zh: 他的日常行為和他的原則不一致。

ex.en: Exercise is part of my daily routine.
ex.zh: 運動是我每天例行的事。

ex.en: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
ex.zh: 外幣匯率每天都在變動。

ex.en: The price of gold fluctuates daily.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在波動。

ex.en: Putting in effort daily is essential to language learning.
ex.zh: 每天下功夫是學好語言的關鍵。

ex.en: My best friend dances really well.
ex.zh: 我最好的朋友舞跳得很好。

ex.en: Emi danced the most beautifully of the three girls.
ex.zh: 三個女孩中，惠美跳得最好看。

ex.en: Would you like to dance?
ex.zh: 你想跳支舞嗎？

dance.en: to move your body to music

ex.en: The dance had already started when I got there.
ex.zh: 我到的時候舞會已經開始了。

ex.en: She learned a traditional dance from her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她跟奶奶學了一支傳統舞蹈。

dance.en: a set of movements done to music, or a social event with music and movement

ex.en: Are you saying that my life is in danger?
ex.zh: 你是說我有生命危險嗎？

ex.en: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
ex.zh: 那座舊橋有倒塌的危險。

ex.en: That is how he got out of danger.
ex.zh: 他就是這樣脫離危險的。

danger.en: the possibility that someone may be hurt or killed

ex.en: It's dangerous to climb a mountain in bad weather.
ex.zh: 天氣不好時爬山很危險。

ex.en: We thought it dangerous for her to go alone.
ex.zh: 我們覺得她一個人去很危險。

ex.en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
ex.zh: 這條河對孩子來說游泳太危險了。

dangerous.en: likely to hurt or harm someone

ex.en: My dad is not at home for the moment.
ex.zh: 我爸爸現在不在家。

ex.en: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
ex.zh: 我爸被我那個蠢問題嚇了一大跳。

ex.en: Dad! Mom! I have some great news for you!
ex.zh: 爸！媽！我有好消息要告訴你們！

ex.en: She didn't dare to say anything at that time.
ex.zh: 那時她什麼都不敢說。

ex.en: I've always wanted to meet her, but I've never dared.
ex.zh: 我一直想認識她，但從來不敢。

ex.en: I don't dare to do that kind of thing.
ex.zh: 我不敢做這種事。

dare.en: to be brave enough to do something

ex.en: How dare you speak to me like that?
ex.zh: 你怎麼敢這麼跟我說話？

ex.en: How dare you read my messages!
ex.zh: 你怎麼敢看我的訊息！

dare.en: used to show that you are very angry about what someone has done

ex.en: I dare say there'll be taxis at the station.
ex.zh: 我想車站應該會有計程車。

ex.en: I dare say you're right.
ex.zh: 我想你說得對。

dare.en: used to say that you think something is probably true

damn.zh: 該死、可惡（表示惱怒，口語）

ex.en: Damn, I left my umbrella on the train.
ex.zh: 可惡，我把雨傘忘在火車上了。

ex.en: Damn! I missed the last bus.
ex.zh: 該死！我錯過末班公車了。

damn.en: used to show that you are angry or annoyed (informal, sometimes offensive)

damn.zh: not give a damn：毫不在乎

ex.en: I don't give a damn what people think about me.
ex.zh: 我才不在乎別人怎麼看我。

ex.en: I don't give a damn what you think of me.
ex.zh: 我不在乎你怎麼看我。

damn.en: to not care at all about something (informal, sometimes offensive)

ex.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
ex.zh: 我們的眼睛需要時間適應黑暗。

ex.en: His black coat blended into the darkness.
ex.zh: 他的黑外套融入了黑暗中。

ex.en: The darkness will work to my advantage.
ex.zh: 黑暗對我有利。

ex.en: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
ex.zh: 天氣不只冷，還很潮濕。

ex.en: Clean the window with a damp cloth.
ex.zh: 用濕抹布擦窗戶。

ex.en: This damp match won't light.
ex.zh: 這根火柴受潮了，點不著。

ex.en: She got all dolled up for her big date.
ex.zh: 為了這次重要的約會，她精心打扮了一番。

ex.en: They went on their first date last Friday.
ex.zh: 他們上週五第一次約會。

date.en: a meeting with someone you have a romantic interest in

ex.en: Who told you that Tom and I are dating?
ex.zh: 誰告訴你我和湯姆在交往的？

ex.en: Dan dated Linda when she was a teenager.
ex.zh: 丹在琳達十幾歲時跟她交往過。

ex.en: Would you ever consider dating your best friend's ex-boyfriend?
ex.zh: 你會考慮跟好朋友的前男友交往嗎？

date.en: to have a romantic relationship with someone

ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
ex.zh: 製造日期印在蓋子上。

ex.en: No one can have three different birth dates.
ex.zh: 沒有人會有三個不同的生日。

date.en: the day of the month, month and year

ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.
ex.zh: 我的車在車禍中嚴重損壞。

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 上週的暴風雨吹壞了我們社區很多樹。

damaged.en: harmed so that it is broken or less good

ex.en: Daddy, I love you!
ex.zh: 爸爸，我愛你！

ex.en: Where did Daddy go?
ex.zh: 爸爸去哪裡了？

ex.en: Daddy loves to say funny things.
ex.zh: 爹地喜歡講有趣的事。

daddy.en: a word children use for their father

dame.zh: 夫人、女爵士（英國授予女性的爵位）

ex.en: The famous actress was made a Dame for her services to theater.
ex.zh: 這位知名女演員因對戲劇界的貢獻而獲封女爵士。

ex.en: Dame Judi Dench is loved by audiences around the world.
ex.zh: 茱蒂．丹契女爵士深受全球觀眾喜愛。

dame.en: the title given to a woman who has received a high honor in Britain

ex.en: I daresay you're tired after such a long trip.
ex.zh: 我想你經過這麼長的旅途一定累了。

ex.en: I daresay they'll be late again tonight.
ex.zh: 我看他們今晚大概又會遲到。

daresay.en: to think that something is probably true

ex.en: The warning light appeared on the dashboard during the drive.
ex.zh: 行駛途中，儀表板上的警示燈亮了。

ex.en: Managers can track monthly sales on the dashboard.
ex.zh: 主管可以在控制面板上追蹤每月銷售額。

dashboard.en: the panel in front of a driver with controls and instruments, or a screen showing information

ex.en: Thank you for the flowers, darling.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的花，親愛的。

ex.en: Come here, darling, and let me help you tie your shoes.
ex.zh: 過來，寶貝，我幫你綁鞋帶。

ex.en: The young singer became the darling of the media.
ex.zh: 這位年輕歌手成了媒體的寵兒。

ex.en: She was the darling of the whole class.
ex.zh: 她是全班的寶貝。

ex.en: What a darling little puppy!
ex.zh: 好可愛的小狗狗！

ex.en: My darling daughter finally came home.
ex.zh: 我親愛的女兒終於回家了。

ex.en: She has been a professional dancer for ten years.
ex.zh: 她當專業舞者已經十年了。

ex.en: The dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
ex.zh: 舞者優雅地在舞台上移動。

ex.en: My cousin is a great dancer and loves hip-hop.
ex.zh: 我表姊舞跳得很好，也很愛嘻哈。

ex.en: We got up at dawn to see the sunrise.
ex.zh: 我們黎明就起床看日出。

ex.en: The birds start singing before dawn.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在天亮前就開始唱歌。

ex.en: Day was just dawning when we left the village.
ex.zh: 我們離開村莊時天剛破曉。

ex.en: It suddenly dawned on me that I had forgotten the tickets.
ex.zh: 我突然意識到我忘了帶票。

ex.en: The dam provides water and electricity for the whole region.
ex.zh: 這座水壩為整個地區提供水和電力。

ex.en: Heavy rain forced the workers to open the dam.
ex.zh: 豪雨迫使工作人員開啟水壩洩洪。

ex.en: They plan to dam the river to make a lake.
ex.zh: 他們打算在河上築壩，形成一座湖。

ex.en: Fallen trees dammed the stream after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，倒下的樹木把小溪堵住了。

ex.en: Dancing is a great way to exercise.
ex.zh: 跳舞是很好的運動方式。

ex.en: She takes dancing lessons on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 她每週六上舞蹈課。

ex.en: There was music and dancing at the wedding.
ex.zh: 婚禮上有音樂和舞蹈。

ex.en: David is a common first name in many countries.
ex.zh: 大衛是許多國家都很常見的名字。

ex.en: David and his brother play basketball every weekend.
ex.zh: 大衛和他的哥哥每個週末都打籃球。

ex.en: Our new neighbor's name is David.
ex.zh: 我們新鄰居的名字是大衛。

ex.en: Dave grills burgers in the backyard every summer.
ex.zh: 戴夫每年夏天都在後院烤漢堡。

ex.en: Could you ask Dave to bring the extra chairs?
ex.zh: 你能請戴夫把多的椅子帶來嗎？

ex.en: Daniel is a name that comes from Hebrew.
ex.zh: 丹尼爾這個名字源自希伯來文。

ex.en: Daniel is one of the most common boys' names in English.
ex.zh: 丹尼爾是英文裡最常見的男孩名字之一。

ex.en: Davis is a common surname in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 戴維斯是英語系國家常見的姓氏。

ex.en: Miles Davis was a famous American jazz musician.
ex.zh: 邁爾士·戴維斯是美國著名的爵士樂手。

ex.en: We should reach the village before daylight fades.
ex.zh: 我們應該在天黑前抵達那座村莊。

ex.en: Daylight streamed through the window and woke me up.
ex.zh: 日光從窗戶灑進來把我叫醒了。

ex.en: In summer, daylight lasts until nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 夏天時，白晝會持續到晚上九點。

ex.en: Charles Darwin was an English naturalist who developed the theory of evolution.
ex.zh: 查爾斯·達爾文是英國博物學家，提出了演化論。

ex.en: Darwin published his famous book On the Origin of Species in 1859.
ex.zh: 達爾文在 1859 年出版了他著名的《物種起源》。

ex.en: I try to eat less dairy because it upsets my stomach.
ex.zh: 我盡量少吃乳製品，因為會讓我肚子不舒服。

ex.en: The dairy near my house sells fresh milk every morning.
ex.zh: 我家附近的乳品店每天早上都賣新鮮牛奶。

ex.en: Cheese and yogurt are dairy products.
ex.zh: 起司和優格都是乳製品。

ex.en: Her uncle runs a dairy farm in the countryside.
ex.zh: 她的叔叔在鄉下經營一座酪農場。

ex.en: She sat on the edge of the dock and let her feet dangle in the water.
ex.zh: 她坐在碼頭邊，讓雙腳在水面上晃啊晃。

ex.en: A small key dangled from the string around his neck.
ex.zh: 一把小鑰匙從他脖子上的細繩垂下來。

ex.en: The boss dangled a bonus in front of the staff to make them work harder.
ex.zh: 老闆用獎金來吊員工胃口，讓他們更努力工作。

ex.en: He dangled the toy above the baby's head.
ex.zh: 他把玩具懸在寶寶頭上晃動。

ex.en: He recently earned his second dan in judo.
ex.zh: 他最近拿到了柔道二段。

ex.en: A player at the fifth dan in Go is very strong.
ex.zh: 圍棋五段的棋手非常強。

ex.en: Smoking is damaging to your health.
ex.zh: 吸菸對你的健康有害。

ex.en: The newspaper printed a damaging report about the company.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇對該公司不利的報導。

ex.en: Strong winds can be very damaging to young trees.
ex.zh: 強風可能對小樹造成嚴重的傷害。

ex.en: She bought a Danish chair for her living room.
ex.zh: 她為客廳買了一張丹麥製的椅子。

ex.en: Danish butter cookies often come in a blue tin.
ex.zh: 丹麥奶油餅乾常常裝在藍色的鐵盒裡。

ex.en: He is a Danish designer who works in Copenhagen.
ex.zh: 他是一位在哥本哈根工作的丹麥設計師。

ex.en: She is learning Danish before moving to Copenhagen.
ex.zh: 她在搬到哥本哈根之前正在學丹麥語。

ex.en: Danish is spoken in Denmark.
ex.zh: 丹麥語在丹麥使用。

ex.en: Online dating has become common among young people.
ex.zh: 線上交友在年輕人之間變得很普遍。

ex.en: Dating can be stressful when you are shy.
ex.zh: 害羞的時候，約會可能會讓人壓力很大。

ex.en: The church is an old building dating back to the 1600s.
ex.zh: 這座教堂是可追溯到十七世紀的古建築。

ex.en: Scientists found tools dating back thousands of years.
ex.zh: 科學家發現了可追溯到數千年前的工具。

ex.en: Don't be daft, you can't swim across that river!
ex.zh: 別傻了，你不可能游過那條河！

ex.en: It was a daft idea to go out without a coat.
ex.zh: 沒穿外套就出門是個傻主意。

ex.en: He threw the dart and hit the center of the board.
ex.zh: 他射出飛鏢，正中靶心。

ex.en: We played darts at the pub on Friday night.
ex.zh: 星期五晚上我們在酒吧玩飛鏢。

ex.en: The cat darted under the sofa when the door slammed.
ex.zh: 門砰地關上時，貓咪飛快地竄到沙發底下。

ex.en: Children darted between the market stalls.
ex.zh: 孩子們在市場攤位間穿梭奔跑。

ex.en: My roommate is a Dane who loves cycling.
ex.zh: 我的室友是個熱愛騎單車的丹麥人。

ex.en: Many Danes ride bikes to work every day.
ex.zh: 許多丹麥人每天騎自行車上班。

ex.en: We walked down into a quiet green dale.
ex.zh: 我們走進一處安靜翠綠的谷地。

ex.en: Sheep were eating grass in the dale below the hills.
ex.zh: 綿羊在山丘下的谷地裡吃草。

ex.en: Moving to a new country can be a daunting task.
ex.zh: 搬到新的國家可能是一件令人卻步的事。

ex.en: The mountain looked daunting to the young climbers.
ex.zh: 這座山在年輕登山者眼中顯得令人望而生畏。

ex.en: The car was driving dangerously close to the truck.
ex.zh: 那輛車開得危險地貼近貨車。

ex.en: The river was dangerously high after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨後河水高得危險。

ex.en: The sky began to darken before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前天空開始變暗。

ex.en: Heavy curtains darken the room at night.
ex.zh: 厚窗簾讓房間在夜裡暗下來。

ex.en: Her hair darkened as she grew older.
ex.zh: 她的頭髮隨著年紀增長而變深。

ex.en: The wood will darken over time.
ex.zh: 木頭會隨著時間顏色變深。

ex.en: The dazzling sunlight made me close my eyes.
ex.zh: 耀眼的陽光讓我閉上了眼睛。

ex.en: She wore a dazzling dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件令人驚豔的洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: The team gave a dazzling performance in the final.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中展現出精彩絕倫的表現。

ex.en: It was a daring plan, but it worked.
ex.zh: 那是個大膽的計畫，但奏效了。

ex.en: She made a daring escape from the burning building.
ex.zh: 她大膽地從著火的建築物中逃了出來。

ex.en: The film is known for its daring story.
ex.zh: 這部電影以大膽的劇情聞名。

ex.en: She picked a daisy and put it in her hair.
ex.zh: 她摘了一朵雛菊別在頭髮上。

ex.en: White daisies covered the field in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時，白色雛菊開滿了整片原野。

darkened.zh: 變暗；使變暗（darken 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The sky darkened just before the rain began.
ex.zh: 下雨前天空暗了下來。

ex.en: He darkened the room by pulling the curtains.
ex.zh: 他拉上窗簾讓房間變暗。

ex.en: Her face darkened when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息時，她的臉色沉了下來。

ex.en: She drops her son off at daycare before going to work.
ex.zh: 她上班前會先把兒子送到托兒所。

ex.en: The daycare center closes at six every evening.
ex.zh: 這間托兒中心每天傍晚六點關門。

ex.en: Good daycare is expensive in many big cities.
ex.zh: 在許多大城市，好的托兒服務費用不低。

ex.en: The museum displays a dagger from the twelfth century.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著一把十二世紀的匕首。

ex.en: In the play, the actor holds a dagger on the stage.
ex.zh: 劇中演員在舞台上握著一把匕首。

ex.en: She dampened a cloth and wiped the table.
ex.zh: 她把布稍微弄濕，擦了擦桌子。

ex.en: The bad news did not dampen his excitement for the trip.
ex.zh: 壞消息並沒有澆熄他對旅行的興奮。

ex.en: His jokes sound a bit dated now.
ex.zh: 他的笑話現在聽起來有點過時了。

ex.en: The kitchen looks dated and needs new cabinets.
ex.zh: 這間廚房看起來老舊過時，需要換新櫥櫃。

ex.en: The letter was dated June 5.
ex.zh: 這封信的日期註明是六月五日。

ex.en: Please bring a dated receipt when you return the item.
ex.zh: 退貨時請攜帶有註明日期的收據。

ex.en: Yellow daffodils bloom in the park every spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天公園裡都會開滿黃色水仙花。

ex.en: She put a bunch of daffodils in a vase.
ex.zh: 她把一束水仙花插進花瓶。

ex.en: Darn, I forgot my keys again!
ex.zh: 可惡，我又忘了帶鑰匙！

ex.en: Oh darn, the store is already closed.
ex.zh: 唉呀，店已經關了。

ex.en: My grandmother used to darn our socks by hand.
ex.zh: 我奶奶以前會用手縫補我們的襪子。

ex.en: She darned the hole in his sweater.
ex.zh: 她把他毛衣上的洞補好了。

ex.en: Dallas is a large city in the state of Texas.
ex.zh: 達拉斯是德州的一座大城市。

ex.en: We drove from Dallas to Houston in four hours.
ex.zh: 我們開車從達拉斯到休士頓花了四個小時。

ex.en: The bright sunlight can dazzle drivers on the road.
ex.zh: 耀眼的陽光會使路上的駕駛人目眩。

ex.en: The magician tried to dazzle the audience with his tricks.
ex.zh: 魔術師想用他的把戲讓觀眾驚豔。

ex.en: The dazzle of the lights made her close her eyes.
ex.zh: 燈光的耀眼光芒讓她閉上了眼睛。

ex.en: The snow-covered field was a dazzle of white.
ex.zh: 被雪覆蓋的田野一片耀眼的白。

ex.en: He glanced darkly at the man who had interrupted him.
ex.zh: 他陰沉地瞥了一眼打斷他的那個人。

ex.en: The sky was darkly overcast just before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，天空陰沉沉地佈滿烏雲。

ex.en: Damascus is the capital of Syria.
ex.zh: 大馬士革是敘利亞的首都。

ex.en: Damascus is often described as one of the oldest cities in the world.
ex.zh: 大馬士革常被形容為世界上最古老的城市之一。

danzig.zh: 但澤（今波蘭格但斯克的舊稱）

ex.en: Danzig is the old German name of the Polish city of Gdansk.
ex.zh: 但澤是波蘭城市格但斯克的舊德語名稱。

ex.en: Danzig was an important port on the Baltic Sea.
ex.zh: 但澤曾是波羅的海上的一個重要港口。

ex.en: She dabbed her eyes with a tissue.
ex.zh: 她用面紙輕拭眼睛。

ex.en: Dab a little cream on the sore spot.
ex.zh: 在疼痛的地方輕輕塗一點藥膏。

ex.en: Add a dab of butter to the hot rice.
ex.zh: 在熱騰騰的飯上加一小塊奶油。

ex.en: He put a dab of glue on each corner of the card.
ex.zh: 他在卡片的每個角上點了一點膠水。

ex.en: She looked dazed after waking from a long nap.
ex.zh: 她睡了很久的午覺醒來後顯得恍恍惚惚。

ex.en: The dazed driver stepped out of the car.
ex.zh: 那名發愣的駕駛走出了車子。

ex.en: He dabbles in photography on weekends.
ex.zh: 他週末會玩玩攝影。

ex.en: She dabbled in painting before choosing music.
ex.zh: 她在選擇音樂之前淺嘗過繪畫。

ex.en: The kids dabbled their feet in the stream.
ex.zh: 孩子們把腳放進溪水裡玩水。

ex.en: Ducks dabbled in the shallow pond.
ex.zh: 鴨子們在淺池塘裡戲水。

ex.en: She served the tea in dainty little cups.
ex.zh: 她用小巧精緻的杯子奉茶。

ex.en: The baby wore a dainty dress with tiny white flowers.
ex.zh: 那個寶寶穿著一件印有小白花的精緻洋裝。

ex.en: The basement was dark, dank and smelled of mold.
ex.zh: 地下室又暗又潮濕，還有一股霉味。

ex.en: We hurried out of the dank cave into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 我們匆匆走出陰濕的山洞，來到陽光下。

ex.en: The child blew on a dandelion and made a wish.
ex.zh: 小孩對著蒲公英吹氣並許了願。

ex.en: Yellow dandelions covered the lawn in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時，黃色的蒲公英開滿了草坪。

darwinian.zh: 達爾文的；達爾文學說的

ex.en: The book explains the Darwinian theory of evolution.
ex.zh: 這本書解釋了達爾文的進化論。

ex.en: The business world can feel like a Darwinian struggle.
ex.zh: 商場有時就像一場適者生存的競爭。

ex.en: The Danube flows through several countries in Europe.
ex.zh: 多瑙河流經歐洲的好幾個國家。

ex.en: We took a boat trip along the Danube last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天我們搭船遊覽了多瑙河。

ex.en: His eyes were far away, lost in a daydream.
ex.zh: 他目光遙遠，沉浸在白日夢裡。

ex.en: The long meeting gave her time for a pleasant daydream.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議讓她有時間做個愉快的白日夢。

ex.en: Students often daydream during boring lessons.
ex.zh: 學生在無聊的課堂上常會發呆做白日夢。

ex.en: I like to daydream about traveling around the world.
ex.zh: 我喜歡幻想環遊世界。

dandy.zh: 花花公子；講究打扮的男人

ex.en: The young dandy spent hours choosing his tie.
ex.zh: 那位年輕的紈褲子弟花了好幾個小時挑領帶。

ex.en: In the old novel, the dandy is known for his fancy clothes.
ex.zh: 在這部老小說裡，那位花花公子以華麗的服裝出名。

ex.en: That's a dandy idea, so let's try it.
ex.zh: 那是個很棒的主意，我們來試試吧。

ex.en: We had a dandy time at the picnic.
ex.zh: 我們在野餐時玩得很開心。

ex.en: He wandered around in a daze after hearing the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息後，他恍恍惚惚地四處走動。

ex.en: She stared at the screen in a daze.
ex.zh: 她茫然地盯著螢幕。

ex.en: The loud noise dazed everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 巨大的聲響讓房裡每個人都愣住了。

ex.en: The fall dazed him for a few seconds.
ex.zh: 那一跤讓他昏沉了幾秒鐘。

ex.en: We bought a new davenport for the living room.
ex.zh: 我們為客廳買了一張新的大沙發。

ex.en: My grandfather used to nap on the old davenport after lunch.
ex.zh: 我爺爺以前午飯後會在那張舊沙發上小睡。

ex.en: He developed the film in a darkroom at school.
ex.zh: 他在學校的暗房沖洗底片。

ex.en: The photographer spent hours in the darkroom.
ex.zh: 攝影師在暗房裡待了好幾個小時。

ex.en: He looked dashing in his new suit.
ex.zh: 他穿上新西裝看起來很帥氣。

ex.en: The actor played a dashing hero in the movie.
ex.zh: 那位演員在電影裡飾演瀟灑的英雄。

ex.en: She wore a dashing red hat to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴著一頂亮眼的紅帽子去參加派對。

dashing.zh: 衝；猛衝（dash 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The children were dashing across the playground.
ex.zh: 孩子們正衝過遊樂場。

ex.en: I saw him dashing for the bus.
ex.zh: 我看到他正衝向公車。

ex.en: We had dal and rice for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了扁豆糊配飯。

ex.en: Dal is a popular Indian dish made from lentils.
ex.zh: 達爾是一道用扁豆做成的印度家常菜。

ex.en: The baby smiled and said "dada" for the first time.
ex.zh: 寶寶笑著第一次說出「爸爸」。

ex.en: Come here and give dada a hug.
ex.zh: 過來給爸爸抱一個。

ex.en: The team shared a large dataset for the research project.
ex.zh: 團隊為這項研究計畫分享了一個大型資料集。

ex.en: We cleaned the dataset before running the analysis.
ex.zh: 我們在做分析前先清理了資料集。

ex.en: The old gentleman looked dapper in his gray suit and hat.
ex.zh: 那位老先生穿著灰色西裝戴著帽子，看起來很俐落有型。

ex.en: He is always dapper, even on casual Fridays.
ex.zh: 他即使在休閒穿著的星期五也總是打扮得整整齊齊。

ex.en: My grandfather was a dapper man who ironed his shirts every morning.
ex.zh: 我祖父是個講究儀容的人，每天早上都會燙襯衫。

ex.en: The rain put a damper on our picnic.
ex.zh: 這場雨讓我們的野餐大為掃興。

ex.en: Bad news can be a damper on the whole mood of the party.
ex.zh: 壞消息可能會讓整場派對的氣氛冷下來。

ex.en: Close the damper to slow the fire in the stove.
ex.zh: 把風門關小，讓爐火燒慢一點。

ex.en: The building has a large damper to reduce shaking in strong winds.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓裝有大型阻尼器，以減少強風時的搖晃。

ex.en: We left the camp at daybreak to avoid the heat.
ex.zh: 我們在破曉時離開營地，以避開高溫。

ex.en: The farmer gets up before daybreak every morning.
ex.zh: 那位農夫每天早上天亮前就起床。

ex.en: The speaker stepped onto the dais and began her speech.
ex.zh: 講者走上講臺，開始她的演講。

ex.en: The guests of honor sat on a raised dais.
ex.zh: 貴賓坐在高起的臺上。

ex.en: Dante was an Italian poet who wrote The Divine Comedy.
ex.zh: 但丁是義大利詩人，寫了《神曲》。

ex.en: We read part of Dante in our literature class.
ex.zh: 我們在文學課讀了但丁的部分作品。

ex.en: She planted red dahlias along the fence.
ex.zh: 她沿著圍籬種了紅色的大理花。

ex.en: A large dahlia stood in the vase.
ex.zh: 花瓶裡插著一朵大大的大理花。

ex.en: The long climb did not daunt the young hikers.
ex.zh: 漫長的攀登沒有嚇倒年輕的登山客。

ex.en: Don't let one failure daunt you.
ex.zh: 別讓一次失敗打倒你。

damning.zh: 極為不利的；足以定罪的

ex.en: The report contained damning evidence against the company.
ex.zh: 這份報告包含了對該公司極為不利的證據。

ex.en: His damning remarks ended the discussion.
ex.zh: 他的嚴厲指責讓討論就此結束。

ex.en: The preacher spoke of eternal damnation.
ex.zh: 傳教士談到永世的沉淪。

ex.en: The movie's villain faced damnation for his crimes.
ex.zh: 電影裡的反派因他的罪行而面臨萬劫不復的下場。

ex.en: The children daubed paint on the wall.
ex.zh: 孩子們把顏料亂塗在牆上。

ex.en: He daubed mud on his face for the costume.
ex.zh: 他為了扮裝在臉上抹了泥巴。

ex.en: There was a daub of paint on her sleeve.
ex.zh: 她的袖子上有一塊顏料污漬。

ex.en: He added a daub of red to the corner of the picture.
ex.zh: 他在畫的角落抹上一點紅色。

ex.en: Don't dawdle, or we'll miss the bus.
ex.zh: 別磨蹭了，不然我們會錯過公車。

ex.en: The kids dawdled on their way home from school.
ex.zh: 孩子們放學回家的路上一路閒晃。

ex.en: She likes to dawdle over a long breakfast on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她週日喜歡慢慢悠悠地吃一頓長長的早餐。

ex.en: In the old tale, a brave knight saves a damsel in distress.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，勇敢的騎士拯救了陷入困境的少女。

ex.en: The painting shows a young damsel by a stream.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一位在溪邊的年輕少女。

ex.en: Dappled sunlight fell through the leaves onto the path.
ex.zh: 斑駁的陽光穿過樹葉灑在小路上。

ex.en: The horse had a dappled grey coat.
ex.zh: 這匹馬有一身斑駁的灰色毛皮。

dark horse.zh: 實力難測的競爭者、黑馬

ex.en: The new player was a dark horse in the tournament.
ex.zh: 這位新球員是比賽中的黑馬。

ex.en: Nobody expected her to win, but she was the dark horse.
ex.zh: 沒人預期她會贏，但她就是那匹黑馬。

dark horse.en: a person who surprises people by doing well
